series.title: The Bulldozer Betrayal

characters.name: Broccoli Bob
characters.look: A big friendly broccoli man with a bushy green floret head, kind round eyes and a thick stalk body, wearing an orange hi-vis vest, yellow hard hat and muddy work boots.

characters.name: Carrot Carl
characters.look: A tall skinny carrot man with a leafy green tuft sticking out of a white hard hat, narrow sly eyes and a wide grin, wearing a spotless blue work shirt with rolled sleeves.

characters.name: Mr Pineapple
characters.look: A stout old pineapple man with a spiky crown of leaves, bushy grey eyebrows and a golden spiky body, wearing a brown suit vest and a clipboard tucked under his arm.

so_far: Part 1: Carrot Carl secretly swaps Broccoli Bob's blueprints, making Bob sink the boss's trailer and get fired while Carl takes his bulldozer.
series.cliffhanger: Carl's first day in Bob's bulldozer begins, but the orange dust on the fake blueprint could expose everything.
